name: benchmark-prompts
description: A collection of prompts intended for evaluating and benchmarking language models' instruction-following and generation abilities across a variety of prompt types. The dataset provides prompt templates and examples that can be used to probe model behavior on open-ended and structured tasks. It is primarily aimed at facilitating prompt-based evaluation and fine-tuning experiments.
reputation: A small community-contributed prompt collection with limited adoption compared to larger, established benchmarks.
